name: cattail_root
what: a cattail root: a pale cream-tan starchy rhizome lying diagonally, segmented with faint rings, a few thin brown root hairs, one cut end showing white starchy flesh

name: cooked_wild_rice
what: a wooden bowl of cooked wild rice seen from the front and slightly above: long slender dark brown-black grains, some split open showing pale insides, a soft shine, centred with 3-5 px of padding
